description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A compact rectangular tray has a tall arched carry handle and one empty circular teapot recess. Side: A rigid bamboo insert supports the recess above the woven sides. Rear: The rear handle roots are heavily wrapped into the back rail. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.

Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
